'''Starship juice''' was a type of drink. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], starship juice could be purchased from kiosks located in the [[Darkside (sector)|Darkside]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
